decision_rule: R2 decides lore. User-approved compatible laws may expand local gameplay and stories. Technical implementation, player state and unapproved proposals cannot promote canon.

lot_011A: Fronteira de Varga local playable overlay

lot_011A_boundaries: The Varga map is a compact local overlay, not a new city or border.
The protagonist and local NPCs have no preexisting R2 authority or identity.
The Vespa incident remains incomplete evidence and a local runtime consequence.
Visual assets require staging and never canonize themselves.
story_generators: A shelter that accepts a displaced traveler conditionally makes compassion measurable.
A route can reopen without proving who created the danger.
A defensive hazard becomes a test of trust rather than a source of trophies.
